node.statement: PRH application: for epsilon := 3*K*eta/(1-3*K*eta), if 0 <= epsilon < 1/2 and ||MA-I||_{infinity->infinity} <= epsilon, then the exact external lem-prh applied to the positive unital maps A and M gives a stochastic idempotent E with ||AM-E||_{infinity->infinity} <= 2*sqrt(2*epsilon).
